$comment: Contract for the Katalon True Platform MCP server. Source: docs.katalon.com/katalon-platform/testops-mcp-server (last updated October 2026), captured 2026-10-20 in the P0 mcp-inventory. The live tools/list needs OAuth and was not available, so this file is the contract. A human diffs a live dump with: node scripts/check-mcp-live.mjs <tools-list.json>. Edit this file only through a reviewed change; scripts/validate-skills.mjs reads it.
countNote: The docs page states 72 unique tools. The capture names 71. One name is unresolved; add it here when a live tools/list shows it.
prefixNote: Skills name tools by bare name. MCP clients add a prefix: Claude Code uses mcp__<server>__<tool>, and mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool> for plugin servers.

classes.read: No side effect. Never needs confirmation.
classes.write: Changes workspace state. Preview, confirm once for the mutation set, execute, read back. Entries with destructiveWhen need an explicit yes naming the target for those actions. Entries with consent need confirmation because they consume TestCloud minutes or can change AUT data.
classes.destructive: Removes or stops something. Needs an explicit yes that names the target.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.notes: Projects the signed-in user can access. Root of every chain.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.notes: Repositories (Test Projects) in a project. repository_id gates the test case, suite and folder tools.

tools.name: find_iterations
tools.notes: Sprints and releases. Relative scope (current, previous, next, active, last N, recent) or a common RSQL filter.

tools.name: find_execution_profiles
tools.notes: Execution profiles. Feeds profile_id for automated runs.

tools.name: get_user_context
tools.notes: Signed-in user profile (whoami). Self only as far as the docs say, so it does not close the assignee lookup gap.

tools.name: find_requirements
tools.notes: Synced Jira or ADO requirements. Read-only mirror.

tools.name: read_requirement
tools.notes: One requirement by requirement_id or key, normalised to Markdown.

tools.name: find_test_cases_by_requirement
tools.notes: Reverse join from requirement to cases. Pass exactly one identifier (requirement_id, key or requirement_external_id); zero or several is a validation error.

tools.name: link_requirements_to_test_case
tools.notes: Link requirements to a test case. Parameters are not documented on the docs page; see the tool schema.

tools.name: unlink_requirements_from_test_case
tools.notes: Remove requirement links from a test case. Parameters are not documented on the docs page; see the tool schema.

tools.name: find_alm_integration_projects
tools.notes: ALM integration projects. Feeds the integration inputs of create_defect.

tools.name: create_defect
tools.notes: Files a real Jira or ADO bug linked to one FAILED test result. External side effect: preview and confirm first. Needs a failed test result ID and the per-project ALM integration, not the account-level Jira connection.

tools.name: find_test_cases
tools.notes: Filtered list with light metadata. Relative filters returned HTTP 500 on one project (2026-08-03). Subfolder search is opt-in.

tools.name: read_test_case
tools.notes: One test case including steps.

tools.name: create_test_case
tools.notes: Creates a MANUAL case. With test_case_type AUTOMATED it creates nothing and returns script guidance. Names accept only letters, digits, spaces and ( ) . , _ -.

tools.name: update_test_case
tools.notes: Metadata and content editor. UPDATE_CONTENT replaces ALL steps, so send the full list.

tools.name: move_test_case
tools.notes: Moves a case and keeps its name. new_folder_path must start with Test Cases.

tools.name: duplicate_test_case
tools.notes: Copies a case in place.

tools.name: delete_test_case
tools.notes: Deletes a case. Unreliable (HTTP 500 observed). Prefer update_test_case or move_test_case.

tools.name: find_test_folders
tools.notes: Lists folders.

tools.name: manage_test_folder
tools.notes: Folder lifecycle through payload.action: CREATE, RENAME, MOVE, DUPLICATE, DELETE.

tools.name: find_test_suites
tools.notes: Lists suites. Relative or common filters (name partial or exact, RSQL).

tools.name: read_test_suite
tools.notes: One suite and its cases.

tools.name: manage_test_suite
tools.notes: Suite lifecycle through payload.action: CREATE, ADD_TEST_CASES, RENAME, MOVE, DUPLICATE, DELETE. Create and add reject mixed MANUAL and AUTOMATED cases.

tools.name: find_test_suite_collections
tools.notes: Lists or reads suite collections by collection_id or name. No create or edit tool exists.

tools.name: read_auts
tools.notes: AUTs and their environments. Call right before a manual run. The tool text carries a private-access decision flow.

tools.name: create_test_run
tools.notes: Single run-creation tool. mode manual or automated, with the matching manual or automated object, an optional schedule (from build_schedule) and an optional private_local_testing_configuration. Manual Run Now returns manualExecutionId and testSuites. Consumes TestCloud minutes and can change AUT data.

tools.name: build_run_configuration
tools.notes: Pure payload builder for automated.configurations. config_type is DESKTOP_AND_MOBILE_BROWSER, MOBILE_NATIVE or API. Creates nothing.

tools.name: build_schedule
tools.notes: Pure payload builder for the schedule object of create_test_run. Creates nothing.

tools.name: build_private_local_testing_config
tools.notes: Pure payload builder for private AUT access, mode tunnel or whitelist. Ask the user before tunnel mode. Creates nothing.

tools.name: create_manual_ai_session
tools.notes: Starts Run with AI against a manual execution. Drives a real browser against the real AUT. Ask the user for browser_profile_mode (SHARED or SEPARATE) and the AUT environment; never infer them. Reuse the private-local configuration unchanged. No cancel tool exists.

tools.name: read_manual_ai_session
tools.notes: Poll a Run with AI session. No push and no cancel.

tools.name: read_manual_test_run_detail_by_order
tools.notes: Finds a manual execution by its order number.

tools.name: rerun_execution
tools.notes: Reruns a COMPLETED execution, optionally limited by job_targets. No stop or cancel tool exists.

tools.name: list_schedule
tools.notes: Saved schedules, filtered by name wildcard.

tools.name: read_schedule_detail
tools.notes: One schedule by schedule_id.

tools.name: update_schedule_configuration
tools.notes: Partial-merge update. Call once with every target schedule in updates.

tools.name: find_test_results
tools.notes: Results at four granularities (filter_type COMMON, RELATIVE, TEST_RESULT, EXECUTION). include_details adds step evidence.

tools.name: read_test_result
tools.notes: One test result. Needed as input for create_defect.

tools.name: read_execution_test_results
tools.notes: Job-grouped results for one execution.

tools.name: read_execution
tools.notes: One execution by numeric TestOps execution_id. start_time only for NOT_RUN.

tools.name: list_executions
tools.notes: Executions in a time window (default last 24 hours) and optional status. Returns numeric TestOps IDs and scheduling metadata only. Never swap with list_execution_outputs.

tools.name: list_execution_outputs
tools.notes: TestCloud execution outputs. Without an execution_id it returns the last 5 executions in 24 hours; with the TestCloud string ID it returns artifact URLs. Never swap with list_executions.

tools.name: update_test_results
tools.notes: Records a manual result or reviews an automated one. Only the outcomes applied and unchanged count as success. A manual result needs an active run assigned to the user; an automated review needs a completed run.

tools.name: prepare_artifact_upload
tools.notes: Returns a signed URL for one evidence file up to 10 MiB.

tools.name: confirm_artifact_upload
tools.notes: Confirms a prepared upload and returns an artifact ID.

tools.name: get_requirement_insights
tools.notes: Requirement coverage per iteration. Replaces fetch_requirement_data.

tools.name: get_defect_insights
tools.notes: Defect distribution by iteration or date range. Replaces fetch_defect_data.

tools.name: get_test_case_insights
tools.notes: Test case execution and automation statistics. Replaces fetch_test_case_data.

tools.name: get_test_configuration_insights
tools.notes: OS and browser coverage and pass rate. Replaces fetch_test_configuration_data.

tools.name: analyze_test_case_stability
tools.notes: Flaky, consistently failing, newly failing and slow tests. Replaces fetch_test_stability_data together with analyze_test_flakiness. Stability data returned all zeros on one project (2026-08-03); cross-check with find_test_results.

tools.name: analyze_test_flakiness
tools.notes: Flakiness over a lookback window with a minimum run count.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_environments
tools.notes: Browser and device catalog. RSQL filter over platform, browser, deviceName, deviceFamily.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_agents
tools.notes: Execution agents in a project.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_apps
tools.notes: Uploaded apps. Quote names with spaces in rsql_filter.

tools.name: get_upload_test_cloud_app_url
tools.notes: Presigned upload URL and storage_path for an app binary.

tools.name: create_test_cloud_app
tools.notes: Registers an uploaded binary. Poll list_test_cloud_apps until the app is READY.

tools.name: manage_test_cloud_dynamic_app
tools.notes: Alias (dynamic) apps. payload.action CREATE or UPDATE. UPDATE silently redirects every consumer of the alias.

tools.name: delete_test_cloud_app
tools.notes: Permanent. The tool text requires the user to type YES.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_tunnels
tools.notes: Active tunnels in a project.

tools.name: prepare_test_cloud_tunnel_start
tools.notes: Returns the setup commands for a tunnel client. test_type MANUAL or AUTOMATED; manual_execution_mode TESTPAK or RUN_WITH_AI.

tools.name: stop_test_cloud_tunnel
tools.notes: Kills a shared tunnel. Other runs may depend on it.

tools.name: list_truetest_auts
tools.notes: Linked AUTs. Yields client_code.

tools.name: list_truetest_tracking_environments
tools.notes: Tracking environments for a client_code.

tools.name: search_truetest_sessions
tools.notes: Captured sessions. Window at most 31 days. Returns an opaque session_reference that must never be constructed.

tools.name: get_truetest_session
tools.notes: Session metadata and replay steps. include_raw_events is capped at 100 and PII-redacted.

tools.name: search_truetest_journey_maps
tools.notes: Lists journey maps by status, dates or creator_email.

tools.name: get_truetest_journey_map
tools.notes: One map with four independent paged cursors (pages, flows, steps, sessions, linked tests).

tools.name: create_truetest_journey_map
tools.notes: Starts an async build job and returns a request_id.

tools.name: get_truetest_journey_map_request
tools.notes: Polls a map build job. Do not auto-resubmit on error.

tools.name: create_truetest_test_case_from_session
tools.notes: Generates test cases from 1 to 25 session IDs. Needs explicit user approval. The Sep 2026 code name differs (see unconfirmed); confirm against a live tools/list.

retired.schedule_test_run: create_test_run with mode automated plus schedule from build_schedule

unconfirmedNote: Names seen in the 2026-09-10 live capture or the server code, absent from the October 2026 docs. Skills must not use them. check-mcp-live reports them when a live dump contains them.

unconfirmed.search: Semantic search over test cases, suites, folders and requirements (2026-09-10 live capture).
unconfirmed.search_external_tool_ops: Meta-tool that finds a Jira, ADO, GitHub, Drive, Figma or Confluence operation (2026-09-10).
unconfirmed.run_external_skill: Runs a bundled external-tracker recipe. Can write (2026-09-10).
unconfirmed.read_test_cases: Batch hydrate by ID. Sep family of read_test_case.
unconfirmed.update_test_cases: Batched update with an action enum. Sep family of update_test_case.
unconfirmed.manage_requirement_test_case_linkages: One polymorphic link and unlink tool. Sep family of link_requirements_to_test_case.
unconfirmed.fetch_defects: Defect linkage lookup by result, case or execution (2026-09-10).
unconfirmed.generate_truetest_test_cases_from_sessio: Server code name for create_truetest_test_case_from_session (capabilities note, 2026-09).

chatgptOnly.name: plan_ai_run
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: Run with AI. The user's click starts the run.

chatgptOnly.name: plan_defect
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: defect draft. The user's click files it.

chatgptOnly.name: review_test_case_drafts
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: draft cases. The user's click saves them.

chatgptOnly.name: app_session_poll
chatgptOnly.notes: Card action that polls a Run with AI session.

nonTools.name: read_secrets
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no secrets tool.

nonTools.name: manage_test_data
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no test data tool.

nonTools.name: create_test_data
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no test data tool.

nonTools.name: manage_tags
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no tag tool.

nonTools.name: create_charter
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no charter tool.

nonTools.name: schedule_id
nonTools.reason: Parameter of read_schedule_detail, not a tool.
